newsitem.title: USA: Hospitality Prop files $500 mln shelf offer.
newsitem.headline: Hospitality Prop files $500 mln shelf offer.

text.p: Hospitality Properties Trust on Monday filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration for up to $500 million in debt securities, preferred securities, depositary shares, common shares and warrants.
Net proceeds will be used for general trust purposes, including acquisition of, or other investments in, hotel and lodging-related projects and the repayment of debt.
Hospitality Properties is a real estate investment trust with headquarters in Newton, Mass. The company, as of September 30, owned 82 hotels located in 26 states.
